user.title: Options
user.description:
Configure the Govee integration. For Details see https://github.com/LaggAt/hacs-govee/blob/master/README.md

⚠️ API Rate Limits: Govee limits to 10,000 requests/24 hours. Daily requests = (86400 / delay) × device_count. Examples:
• 4 devices @ 300s = 1,152 req/day ✓ Safe
• 4 devices @ 60s = 5,760 req/day ✓ Safe
• 4 devices @ 10s = 34,560 req/day ✗ Rate limited!

Recommended: 300s (5 min) for background polling. Enable 'assumed state' for instant UI feedback when controlling lights.
